personas.name: First-Time User (Happy Path)
personas.goal: Admin seals a secret password with default settings, retrieves the Claim URL and Unlock Key, opens the Claim view, enters the PIN, and reveals/decrypts the secret with ML-KEM-768 and ML-DSA-44 verification.
instructions: First, enter a strong password into the secret input.
Click the primary 'Seal & Create Share Link' button.
After confirmation appears, read the Claim URL and PIN.
Navigate to the Claim URL, fill in the Unlock Key, and click 'Reveal / Decrypt'.
Assert the decrypted password appears and return action='done'.

personas.name: Edge-Case & Validation Explorer
personas.goal: Attempt empty secret submission to verify zero-network validation, seal a secret, test an incorrect PIN on claim view to verify 403 non-burn preservation, and test duplicate reveal on burned escrow.
instructions: First click 'Seal & Create Share Link' with empty input to test client validation.
Verify error message appears and no network calls are dispatched.
Enter a secret and seal it.
On claim view, intentionally enter an incorrect PIN and assert HTTP 403 non-burn warning.
Enter the correct PIN to reveal.
Attempt to reveal again and assert HTTP 409 burned message.

personas.name: Mobile Handheld User (Galaxy S21 Ultra 412x915)
personas.goal: Exercise mobile touch affordances on Samsung Galaxy S21 Ultra: cycle through embargo presets, test date picker, enter secret and custom PIN, seal, test copy buttons, and assert 0px horizontal overflow across all steps.
instructions: Touch preset buttons (+30s, +1h, +24h, Custom) to test active styling.
Enter a secret and custom PIN.
Click 'Copy SMS Body' button to test clipboard interaction.
Verify 0px horizontal overflow and 0 clipped affordances.
